name: Village pork skewers
summary: Thịt lợn bản xiên is skewered village pork, one of the grills Sa Pa eats on a cold night by the lake.
origin: Sa Pa town grills, where village pork goes on skewers beside salmon, wings, and chestnuts.
howToEat: Eat it off the skewer at the stall, with the other cold-night grills.
where: The grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, on cold evenings.
seoTitle: Village pork skewers in Sapa — a cold-night grill
seoDescription: Thịt lợn bản xiên, skewered village pork, on the cold-night grills at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.
